annotation.evidence_span: When received options are passed up to TCP from the IP layer, TCP implementations MUST ignore options that it does not understand (MUST-50).
annotation.interpretation_a: TCP removes the unknown option from the TCP header before further processing.
annotation.interpretation_b: TCP leaves the unknown option in the TCP header unchanged, simply ignoring it for processing purposes.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify whether the option should be discarded or retained, leading to two materially different implementation behaviours.
annotation.missing_information: Whether the unknown option should be removed from the TCP header or left unchanged.
